business.identityHint: Shown at the top of every receipt and invoice.
business.name: Business name
business.nameHint: Trading name shown on the lock screen and receipts
business.legalNameHint: Registered company name for tax invoices, if different
business.logoHint: PNG, JPG or SVG. Printed in black and white on thermal paper.
business.logoError: That image could not be read
business.emailInvalid: This doesn't look like an email address
business.regionHint: Controls tax labels and India GST place of supply.
business.countryHint: Changing the country offers to apply its currency, tax rates and payment methods.
business.stateHint: Place of supply for GST (CGST + SGST within the state, IGST outside)
business.taxNumberHint: Your tax registration number, printed on invoices
business.presetSubtitle: Apply this country's defaults to your store:
business.presetNote: Existing tax rates and products are kept; missing rates are added. You can fine-tune everything afterwards.

taxes.futureOnly: Tax changes apply to new sales only. Past receipts keep the tax they were sold with.
taxes.ratesHint: Assign a rate to each product. The default rate is used for new products and custom items.
taxes.emptyHint: Add the rates your business charges, e.g. VAT 20% or GST 18%.
taxes.name: Name
taxes.rateChangeWarning_one: {{count}} product uses this rate. Its future sales will be taxed at the new rate.
taxes.rateChangeWarning_other: {{count}} products use this rate. Their future sales will be taxed at the new rate.
taxes.deleteHint: The rate disappears from lists and new sales. Past sales keep it.
taxes.inclusiveHint: Shelf prices already contain tax; receipts show the tax portion.
taxes.exclusiveHint: Tax is added on top of product prices at checkout.
taxes.gstModeHint: Splits tax into CGST + SGST, or IGST for inter-state sales, and prints HSN codes.

formats.currencyHint: Used for prices, receipts and reports
formats.currencyWarning: Changing currency does not convert existing prices, sales or balances.
formats.decimalsChange: {{from}} and {{to}} use a different number of decimal places. Prices, sales and balances are not converted, so every existing amount changes size: {{before}} will show as {{after}}. Re-enter your prices after switching.
formats.numberLocaleHint: Digit grouping and decimal separator. Independent of the app language.
formats.cashRoundingHint: Round sale totals to the smallest coin in circulation.

checkout.allowNegativeStockHint: Stock can go below zero; otherwise the till blocks the sale
checkout.requireShiftHint: Cashiers must open the cash register (with a float) before selling
checkout.orderTypesHint: Ask for dine-in, takeaway or delivery and a table number on each sale
checkout.lockAfterSaleHint: The next cashier enters their PIN — ideal for shared tills
checkout.autoLockHint: Locks the till after a period without touches or keys
checkout.paymentsHint: Turn methods on or off and set the order they appear in at checkout.

method.bank: NEFT, IMPS, wire or bank deposit

checkout.quickCashHint: Banknotes suggested when taking cash payments.
checkout.quickCashEmpty: No notes — only “Exact” will be offered.
checkout.upiTitleHint: Customers scan a QR code with any UPI app; the amount is filled in automatically.
checkout.upiDisabled: UPI is turned off in payment methods above. Turn it on to accept UPI at checkout.
checkout.upiIdHint: The ID payments go to, e.g. shopname@okhdfcbank
checkout.upiInvalid: A UPI ID looks like name@bank
checkout.upiNameHint: Shown in the customer's UPI app. Defaults to your business name.
checkout.upiQrEmpty: Enter a UPI ID to see your QR code
checkout.upiScan: Scan & pay with any UPI app
checkout.loyaltyTitleHint: Reward returning customers with points they can spend at checkout.

checkout.loyaltyPointValueHint: Discount a customer gets for each point redeemed
checkout.loyaltyPointValueRange: Enter an amount of 0 or more
checkout.loyaltyTooGenerous: With these rates customers get back as much as they spend, or more. Check the points per unit and the value of a point.

receipt.headerHint: Printed under your business details, e.g. opening hours
receipt.footerHint: e.g. return policy, thank-you message, social handles
receipt.showLogoHint: Your business logo at the top of receipts

receipt.showTaxBreakdownHint: List tax per rate (CGST/SGST in GST mode)

receipt.paperWidthHint: 58 mm and 80 mm thermal rolls, or A4 invoices
receipt.autoPrintHint: Print the receipt as soon as a sale is completed
receipt.copiesHint: Number of receipts printed per sale
receipt.printFailed: The receipt could not be printed
receipt.previewHint: Sample sale — updates as you type

scale.intro: Weighing scales print EAN-13 labels that contain the item code and the weight or price. Match these settings to your scale's label format.
scale.enabledHint: Scanned labels add the item with its weight or price
scale.layoutHint: How the 13 digits on your scale's labels are split.
scale.tooLong: Too many digits: prefix, item code and value must fit in 12 digits.
scale.prefixesHint: Leading digits that mark scale labels, separated by commas, e.g. 2 or 20, 21, 22
scale.itemDigitsHint: Matched against the product's SKU or barcode
scale.weightHint: The value is the weight; the price comes from the product
scale.priceHint: The value is the line total; the quantity is worked out from the unit price
scale.testHint: Scan or type a label to check what the till will read.
scale.noMatch: Not a scale barcode with these settings (check the prefix and digit counts).
scale.noProduct: No product with this SKU or barcode

device.intro: These settings apply only to this till. Each terminal can have its own language, theme and printer.
device.terminalHint: 2–6 letters or digits, used in invoice numbers: {{example}}
device.terminalInvalid: Use 2 to 6 capital letters or digits
device.terminalClash: Another till already issued invoices with the code {{code}}. Each till needs its own code.
device.terminalChangeMessage: New invoices from this till will be numbered like {{example}}. Existing invoices keep their numbers. Make sure no other till uses {{code}}.
device.terminalNameHint: A friendly name, e.g. Front counter
device.themeHint: Dark mode is easier on the eyes in dim restaurants and bars
device.languageHint: Language of this till's screens and receipts
device.cartSideHint: Put the cart on the side your cashiers prefer
device.gridSizeHint: Larger tiles are easier to tap on touch screens
device.showImagesHint: Turn off for a faster, denser grid
device.soundHint: Beep on scans and completed sales
device.cameraScannerHint: Show a button to scan barcodes with the device camera
device.printerDesktopHint: Pick the receipt printer for this till.
device.printerBrowserHint: Receipts print through your system's print dialog.
device.noPrinters: No printers found. Check that the printer is installed and switched on.
device.silentPrintHint: Send receipts straight to the printer (desktop app only)
device.browserTip1: For thermal printers, choose paper size 80 mm (or 58 mm) and set margins to None.
device.browserTip2: Turn off headers and footers in the print dialog for a clean receipt.
device.browserTip3: Install the OpenPOS desktop app to print silently to a chosen printer.
device.testPageFooter: If every line above is clear and fits the paper, your printer is ready.

sync.connectionHint: Terminals connected to the same server share products, customers, sales and users.
sync.serverUrlHint: The URL of your OpenPOS sync server
sync.urlInvalid: Enter a full address starting with http:// or https://
sync.mixedContent: This app is open over https://, and browsers block connections from it to an http:// server. Use an https:// address for the server, or use the desktop app on this till.
sync.storeKeyHint: The secret key shown when the server was set up
sync.enabledHint: Send and receive changes automatically when online
sync.enabledNeedsServer: Add a server address and store key first
sync.lanHint: Run the OpenPOS sync server on any PC in your shop and use its local address. Tills keep selling offline and catch up when the PC is back.
sync.cloudHint: Deploy the same server to any host with HTTPS to connect branches and check sales from anywhere.
sync.readme: Setup, store keys and the HTTP API are described in

backup.neverTitle: This device has never been backed up
backup.staleHint: Export a backup regularly and keep it somewhere safe — another computer, a USB stick or cloud storage.
backup.exportHint: Downloads every product, customer, sale and setting on this device as one file.
backup.importHint: Replaces everything on this device with the contents of a backup file.
backup.replaceWarningTitle: All data on this device will be replaced
backup.replaceWarning: Sales, products, customers, users and settings made after this backup will be lost. Export a fresh backup first if unsure.
backup.confirmMessage: Everything on this device will be replaced with the backup from {{date}}. This cannot be undone.

error.notJson: That file is not a valid backup (it isn't JSON).
error.notKasa: That file is not an OpenPOS backup.
error.newerVersion: This backup was made by a newer version of OpenPOS. Update the app first.
error.badTables: The backup file is damaged and cannot be restored.
error.noUsers: The backup contains no users, so nobody could sign in after restoring.

audit.logHint: Filter by action, user and date

danger.erase: Erase all data on this device
danger.eraseHint: Use this before selling or recycling the device, or to start again from scratch.
danger.eraseWhat1: Deletes every product, customer, sale, user and setting stored on this device.
danger.eraseWhat2: Resets this terminal's language, theme, printer and server connection.
danger.eraseWhat3: Data already synced to your store server and other tills is not affected.
danger.confirmMessage: This permanently deletes all data on this device and restarts the app. It cannot be undone.

about.tagline: Offline-first point of sale for every device
about.storageHint: Space used by the local database
about.storageUnknown: This browser doesn't report storage usage.
about.persistOn: The browser won't clear your data when the device is low on space.
about.persistOff: The browser may clear data under storage pressure. Keep regular backups.
about.persistDenied: The browser declined. Install the app or keep regular backups.
about.shortcutsHint: Function keys for fast selling on desktop tills

autoBackup.scheduleHint: OpenPOS makes a backup whenever one is due and sends it to every destination you switch on below.
autoBackup.keepHint: Per folder or cloud account; older ones are deleted
autoBackup.onShiftClose: Also back up when a shift is closed
autoBackup.onShiftCloseHint: The day's takings are final then, so it's a good moment
autoBackup.encryptHint: Recommended for cloud backups: they contain customer details and staff PINs
autoBackup.passphraseSaved: Passphrase saved. New backups will be encrypted.
autoBackup.passphraseWarning: Write the passphrase down. Without it, encrypted backups can't be restored — not even by us.
autoBackup.whileOpen: Backups run while OpenPOS is open. If one is missed, it runs the next time the app opens.
autoBackup.noneEnabled: Switch on at least one destination first
autoBackup.destinationsHint: Use at least one that isn't this device, so a lost or broken device doesn't take your data with it.
autoBackup.deviceHint: Recent copies kept inside OpenPOS. Protects against mistakes, not against losing the device.
autoBackup.folderHint: Tip: choose your Google Drive, OneDrive or Dropbox folder and the desktop app will sync it to the cloud.
autoBackup.folderUnsupported: Available in Chrome, Edge and the OpenPOS desktop app.
autoBackup.notConfigured: Not set up for this installation yet. See “Automatic backups” in docs/DEPLOYMENT.md.
autoBackup.desktopUseFolder: Not available in the desktop app yet. Use “Folder on this computer” and choose your {{name}} folder instead.
autoBackup.mobileUseFile: Not available in the mobile app yet. Download a backup from Backup & restore and save it to {{name}}.

hint.gdrive: Saved in a “OpenPOS Backups” folder in your Google Drive.
hint.onedrive: Saved in this app's own folder under Apps in your OneDrive.
hint.dropbox: Saved in this app's own folder under Apps in your Dropbox.

autoBackup.disconnectHint: Backups already saved there stay where they are.
autoBackup.popupBlocked: The sign-in window was blocked. Allow pop-ups for this site and try again.

needs.reconnect: Signed out — sign in again to resume backups

autoBackup.encryptedFileHint: Enter the passphrase this backup was encrypted with.
autoBackup.wrongPassphrase: That passphrase doesn't open this backup.
